newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DOCDATA BUYS BUSINESS OF MAYKING.
newsitem.headline: DOCDATA BUYS BUSINESS OF MAYKING.

text.p: DOCdata NV said on Monday it had acquired the business and related assets of Britain's Mayking Multimedia Ltd and Mayking Cassettes Ltd, both of which are in administration.

DOCdata said it acquired the Mayking business for a cash consideration of about 11 million stg, financed by part of the initial public offering proceeds of DOCdata NV in combination with bank financing.
The Mayking companies are based in Britain with facilities for the production of CDs and music cassettes in London's Battersea and have approximately 250 employees.
The business will be continued by DOCdata UK Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of DOCdata NV.
Mayking Multimedia and Mayking Cassettes encountered cash flow problems with respect to financial lease commitments arising from the purchase of new CD production equipment.
